jobs.description:
Description

About the Role

The Enterprise Architecture & Engineering Sr. Director is a strategic technology leader responsible for defining and executing MyEyeDr.'s enterprise architecture, engineering, integration, and platform modernization strategy. This leader will drive the design and evolution of business-critical technology capabilities that enable growth, scalability, operational excellence, and digital innovation across the enterprise.

Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer, this role serves as a trusted advisor to executive leadership and business stakeholders, shaping technology investments, architectural standards, engineering practices, and modernization roadmaps. The Senior Director will lead the enterprise architecture function while establishing modern engineering disciplines, cloud-native capabilities, API-first platforms, event-driven architectures, and enterprise integration strategies that support current and future business objectives.

This position is accountable for creating a future-state technology landscape that delivers resiliency, agility, security, interoperability, and business value across clinical, retail, corporate, and customer-facing systems.

The hiring range for this position is $235,000 to $265,000 annually, exclusive of benefits or bonuses (discretionary and non-discretionary), based on experience and proximity to the Vienna Home Office.

You Will

Define and execute the enterprise architecture vision, strategy, standards, and governance framework aligned with business priorities and corporate growth objectives.
Develop multi-year architecture and technology modernization roadmaps that support enterprise transformation initiatives.
Lead architecture governance processes and review boards to ensure alignment with strategic technology principles and investment priorities.
Partner closely with executive leadership, product, operations, security, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to translate business objectives into scalable technology solutions.
Establish reference architectures, technology standards, design patterns, and engineering principles across the organization.
Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, identifying opportunities to accelerate innovation, operational efficiency, and competitive advantage.
Lead the evolution of modern software engineering practices, including DevSecOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), CI/CD automation, Infrastructure as Code, platform engineering, and developer experience initiatives.
Establish enterprise engineering standards that improve software quality, scalability, observability, security, and operational resilience.
Build and mature cloud-native engineering capabilities leveraging microservices, containerization, Kubernetes, serverless technologies, and platform services.
Drive modernization of legacy applications through refactoring, replatforming, and cloud migration strategies.
Champion engineering excellence through architecture reviews, design reviews, performance optimization, and technical mentoring.
Define enterprise integration strategies utilizing API-first, event-driven, and service-oriented architectural patterns.
Lead architecture for enterprise integrations across clinical, retail, ERP, CRM, HR, finance, and customer experience platforms.
Establish standards for APIs, event streams, messaging platforms, data integration, and interoperability.
Oversee design of scalable integration frameworks leveraging cloud-native services, API gateways, event brokers, and messaging platforms.
Develop enterprise data architecture principles that support real-time analytics, business intelligence, AI initiatives, and operational reporting.
Govern cloud architecture across Azure, AWS, and emerging platform technologies.
Drive adoption of enterprise platform services, including identity management, API management, observability, caching, container orchestration, secrets management, and integration services.
Establish standards for scalability, resiliency, disaster recovery, cost optimization, and cloud governance.
Lead technology architecture efforts supporting digital transformation, automation, artificial intelligence, machine learning, and intelligent process optimization initiatives.

About You

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
15+ years of progressive experience designing, developing, and implementing enterprise technology solutions.
10+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, software architecture, or technology leadership roles.
5+ years leading architecture, engineering, or platform teams in complex enterprise environments.
Experience supporting large-scale retail, healthcare, multi-site, or customer-centric organizations preferred.
Deep expertise in enterprise architecture frameworks, governance models, and strategic technology planning.
Proven experience designing and implementing cloud-native architectures on Azure and/or AWS.
Strong experience with modern software engineering practices including DevSecOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and platform engineering.
Demonstrated success building microservices-based, API-first, and event-driven architectures.
Experience with container platforms such as Kubernetes and modern orchestration technologies.
Expertise with API management platforms, OpenAPI standards, GraphQL, RESTful services, and enterprise integration patterns.
Experience implementing identity and access management solutions leveraging OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, and Zero Trust principles.
Knowledge of enterprise messaging technologies, event streaming platforms, and asynchronous integration patterns.
Strong understanding of data architecture, data governance, relational databases, NoSQL platforms, and modern analytics ecosystems.
Experience establishing observability practices, including monitoring, logging, tracing, and operational intelligence solutions.
Familiarity with AI-enabled architectures, automation platforms, and emerging digital technologies.
Strategic thinker with the ability to balance long-term vision and near-term business outcomes.
Exceptional executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
Proven ability to influence cross-functional leaders and drive enterprise-wide transformation.
Strong business acumen with experience aligning technology decisions to organizational objectives.
Highly organized and capable of managing multiple strategic initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

Grow with Us

Career Development and Training Opportunities
Participate in a comprehensive benefits package including medical and dental coverage, tax-free savings plans, life insurance and more
Participate in our Vision coverage and associate discounts on our products
Participate in our 401(k) with competitive company match
Accrue PTO and paid holidays from day one

How do you see yourself today? Are you looking for that unique opportunity where you can make a difference in the lives of the patients we serve? MyEyeDr. is a high-growth, premier healthcare company: a total vision care concept with a unique retail experience. Our trusted community doctors and knowledgeable teams are all focused on helping our patients live their best lives by delivering an exceptional, personalized experience to each of our patients in every interaction. Our business model is unlike others in the industry: we make healthcare accessible by welcoming all insurance and providing a great selection of stylish eyewear that meets the diverse needs of our patients.

You would have the opportunity to prioritize the care of our associates and our patients, to connect the knowledge of our talented teams to our patients’ needs, and to work in a fun, inclusive environment as part of a collaborative team. Advanced SENTRY LLC

Security - All We Do

Advanced SENTRY is seeking an experienced, highly connected Vice President, Data Center Infrastructure Solutions & Technical Enablement
to help lead the expansion of our data center infrastructure, technical workforce, strategic partnerships, and integrated security solutions.

This is a hands-on executive leadership position for an individual who understands how modern data centers are built, operated, protected, staffed, and supported — and who has established relationships throughout the data center, cloud, colocation, telecommunications, infrastructure, and technology ecosystem.

The ideal candidate will combine deep technical infrastructure experience with the ability to develop people, establish repeatable processes, build strategic relationships, open new business opportunities, and translate technical customer requirements into scalable solutions.

The Opportunity

Advanced SENTRY is expanding beyond traditional security services through our Security - All We Do
model.

Our Approach Brings Together

Physical security
Data center infrastructure support
Technical workforce solutions
Critical facility operations
Cybersecurity coordination and response
Access and asset protection
Incident and emergency response
Strategic workforce deployment

The Vice President of Data Center Infrastructure Solutions & Technical Enablement will play a key role in building and scaling this model.

This individual will work across operations, recruiting, training, sales, strategic partnerships, infrastructure services, and security leadership
to develop a repeatable Advanced SENTRY capability for supporting mission-critical environments.

Key Responsibilities

Data Center Infrastructure Leadership

Provide technical leadership for Advanced SENTRY's data center and infrastructure services, including:

Data center deployments and expansions
Rack and stack operations
Structured cabling
Fiber and copper infrastructure
Server and network commissioning
Smart Hands and Remote Hands services
Hardware deployments and decommissions
Network and infrastructure troubleshooting
Power and cooling readiness
Asset and inventory management
Hardware lifecycle and RMA coordination
Data center moves, adds, changes, and expansions
Colocation and vendor coordination

Help Advanced SENTRY evaluate customer requirements and develop the appropriate technical workforce, processes, documentation, and execution strategy for each engagement.

Strategic Relationships & Business Development

A major responsibility of this position is developing and leveraging relationships throughout the data center and critical-infrastructure ecosystem.

The VP Will

Develop relationships with cloud providers, colocation operators, data center owners, infrastructure companies, contractors, technology vendors, ISPs, and strategic partners
Identify and develop new infrastructure and security opportunities
Create introductions between Advanced SENTRY and key industry decision-makers
Support executive-level customer meetings
Participate in technical discovery and solution-development discussions
Help convert relationships into strategic partnerships and revenue opportunities
Serve as a technical advisor during the sales process
Assist with solution scoping, staffing strategies, proposals, and statements of work
Expand Advanced SENTRY's visibility and credibility throughout the data center industry

This position requires someone who can build relationships at both the technical and executive level
.

Technical Workforce Development

Work directly with Advanced SENTRY's recruiting organization to build a scalable pipeline of qualified infrastructure professionals.

Responsibilities Include

Establishing technical requirements for data center positions
Developing technician competency standards
Creating technical interview and screening criteria
Participating in technical candidate evaluations
Identifying high-potential technicians
Establishing technician levels and career progression
Supporting recruiting teams in understanding technical job requirements
Developing workforce plans for infrastructure projects and customer deployments

Training & Technical Enablement

Develop and lead Advanced SENTRY's technical training and enablement program.

The VP Will Help Create Standardized Training For

Data Center Technicians
Deployment Technicians
Smart Hands Technicians
Network and Infrastructure Technicians
Lead Technicians
Infrastructure Project Leads

Training should include both classroom and practical instruction covering topics such as:

Rack and stack procedures
Structured cabling
Fiber and copper standards
Cable management and labeling
Server installation and commissioning
Network equipment installation
Port maps and rack elevations
Power and cooling awareness
Hardware troubleshooting
Linux and infrastructure fundamentals
Change management
MOP execution
Incident escalation
Documentation standards
Data center safety and customer-site conduct

A key objective will be developing train-the-trainer capabilities
so Advanced SENTRY can continuously develop qualified technical personnel at scale.

Process Development & Standardization

Create repeatable operational standards that can be used across Advanced SENTRY infrastructure engagements.

Develop And Maintain

Standard Operating Procedures
Methods of Procedure
Deployment checklists
Data center readiness assessments
Quality-control standards
Technician evaluation procedures
Escalation procedures
Change-management processes
Incident-response procedures
Rack-build standards
Cabling standards
Asset-management procedures
Site documentation
Customer acceptance and project closeout processes

The successful candidate will turn technical knowledge and field experience into systems that can be taught, measured, repeated, and scaled.

Integrated Physical & Cyber Security

Advanced SENTRY believes protecting critical infrastructure requires more than simply protecting the front door.

Modern data centers require multiple layers of protection involving people, facilities, infrastructure, systems, vendors, contractors, assets, and information.

This position will work with Advanced SENTRY's physical security and cybersecurity resources to help develop integrated protection strategies involving:

Physical facility security
Data center access control
Contractor and technician access
Asset protection
Chain of custody
Restricted-area procedures
Infrastructure monitoring
Incident escalation
Operational resilience
Business continuity
Physical and cyber incident coordination
Infrastructure security procedures
Layered protection of mission-critical environments

The VP is not expected to function solely as a cybersecurity practitioner but must understand how physical security, infrastructure operations, and cybersecurity requirements intersect inside mission-critical facilities.

Ability to translate technical requirements into staffing and operational solutions

About Us

We're living through a fundamental shift in how people discover, evaluate, and purchase products. The next generation doesn't respond to traditional marketing -- they build relationships with brands through authentic social interactions, seek recommendations from communities they trust, and expect personalized experiences that feel human, not corporate.

At Nectar Social, we're building the AI-native social operating system that enables this new era of commerce. We believe every social interaction should deepen the relationship between brands and their communities while creating genuine value for both sides.

Founded by ex-Meta product and engineering leaders, we've raised over $30M in total capital from investors including GV and True Ventures. We work with brands like Oura Health, Caraway, e.l.f. Cosmetics, Kosas, OLIPOP, and many more. We're building the future of social commerce -- where community, conversation, and commerce converge.

The Role

We are looking for a Director of Engineering
who operates with the mindset of a product executive to lead, align, and scale our core engineering organization. Our team includes multiple core engineering groups focused on customer-facing product development, as well as a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) function that moves fast across the full stack on high-priority enterprise initiatives. Under your leadership, these teams will build and scale high-throughput systems that ingest large volumes of social data, run real-time AI agents, and deliver insights through analytics and automation.

This is an executive-level leadership role that bridges technical vision, organizational scale, and business strategy. At the same time, you will build and empower high-performing engineering teams, manage engineering managers and leads, establish systemic technical quality, and guide our engineering organization as we scale from ~50 people into our next phase of growth.

What You'll Be Doing

Organizational Leadership & Team Scaling: Lead, manage, and mentor a high-performing engineering organization, including Engineering Managers and Tech Leads. Build scalable org structures, career ladders, and succession plans to retain top talent.
Product & Strategic Alignment: Partner directly with the CEO and executive peers to define long-term roadmaps, align engineering capacity with business priorities, and turn product vision into predictable technical execution.
Technical Vision & System Governance: Set the high-level technical strategy, architecture principles, and infrastructure roadmap. Ensure scalable system architecture across teams handling high-volume real-time data and AI agentic workflows.
Execution & Delivery Excellence: Drive operational rigor across all engineering teams. Establish clear metrics for delivery velocity, system reliability, code quality, and operational health.
Customer & Market Empathy: Engage directly with key enterprise customers and prospects to understand user pain points, build deep business intuition, and ensure technical investments map directly to business value.
Engineering Culture & Processes: Shape engineering culture as the company scales. Refine organizational processes around architecture reviews, incident response, resource allocation, and continuous improvement.
Hiring & Employer Brand: Partner with Talent Acquisition to scale the engineering department, driving talent acquisition strategies, executive hiring, and interviewing standards for top-tier technical talent.

What We're Looking For

Experience Level: 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in a senior leadership role (Director, Head of Engineering) managing managers and leading multi-team organizations.
Track Record of Scaling: Proven experience growing engineering teams and organizational structures through key growth phases (e.g., scaling orgs from 30 to 100+ engineers).
Strategic Product Acumen: Strong business and product instincts with a track record of translating complex product objectives into achievable engineering roadmaps and resource plans.
Technical Depth: Deep foundational technical background with the ability to hold engineering teams accountable, evaluate high-level architectural trade-offs, and participate in complex technical discussions.
Executive Cross-Functional Collaboration: History of working seamlessly alongside Product, Design, Sales, and Customer Success executives in fast-paced startup environments.
Operational Mastery: Demonstrated ability to implement light-footprint, high-impact processes that maintain speed and quality without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.
Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting technical strategy to executive leadership, boards, and customers.

Bonus Points

Domain Expertise: Experience leading engineering teams in B2B SaaS, social data platforms, developer tools, or marketing technology.
AI & Data Infrastructure at Scale: Experience overseeing teams building, deploying, or operating AI-powered systems, real-time analytics platforms, or agentic frameworks.
Tech Stack Alignment: Strategic familiarity with modern cloud and data stacks such as AWS, TypeScript/React, Postgres, ClickHouse, and modern infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Pulumi).
Cross-Platform Leadership: Executive oversight of teams delivering both web and native mobile application ecosystems.

Compensation Range: $250K - $325K

jobs.description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.

P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.

The Opportunity

Postman is seeking a strategic and results-driven engineering leader who is passionate about APIs, partnerships, ecosystems, collaboration, and developer success.

As the Sr. Engineering Manager for Ecosystems & Integration, you’ll build and lead a talented group of engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence while guiding the team to build scalable, reliable, high-performance features that power the future of our Ecosystem. You’ll work closely with other engineering managers, product managers, and designers to drive the vision and execution of the product roadmap that will empower developers + partners to create rich, integrated experiences that will help teams create, collaborate, manage, and scale their APIs and solutions. This position requires a strategic thinker with a deep understanding of developer ecosystems and a passion for delivering exceptional developer experiences. You will define our technical strategy to achieve our ecosystem goals, including how extensibility, integration frameworks and public APIs work at Postman, how integrations look, feel, and behave to our end users, and how customers discover, install, and buy apps via a marketplace.

If you’re passionate about building products that make an impact, have a proven track record of leading engineering teams to success, and thrive in dynamic, fast-paced environments, we want you on our team!

What You’ll Do

Team Leadership & Development

Hire, manage, mentor, and coach several teams of engineers, helping them grow both technically and professionally.
Drive and uphold a culture of respect, integrity, inclusion, ownership, and accountability within the team.
Set clear goals and provide regular feedback to ensure your team is motivated and aligned with the product and company vision.
Design strategies for developer success across many areas, including those that are still in the early stages of finding their product-market fit.
Experiment, design, and influence rigorously the creation of new kinds of experiences for consumers and the new business models that will support builders, creators, partners, and developers.

Technical Leadership

Facilitate and coordinate the technical design and execution of complex features for Postman’s ecosystem platform ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability for millions of customers and partners everywhere.
Partner with leaders at strategic companies in the ecosystem to define high value product offerings through Postman app as well as the partner app and marketplaces.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and other engineering managers, to deliver high-quality, customer-focused features.
Ensure engineering best practices are upheld, including code reviews, testing, and continuous delivery.

Project Management

Own the engineering roadmap for Ecosystem, including Developer Tooling, Strategic Integrations and Marketplace, balancing short-term delivery with long-term technical and business investments.
Break down complex initiatives into clear, actionable milestones and manage the delivery of these projects on time.
Proactively identify and resolve roadblocks, ensuring your team meets its deadlines and delivers features with high quality.

Collaboration & Communication

Work closely with stakeholders across engineering, product, and design teams to ensure alignment on priorities and deliverables.
Foster open communication within the team, promoting collaboration and transparency.
Represent the engineering team in meetings with leadership, advocating for technical needs and constraints while aligning with broader company goals.

Operational Excellence

Ensure the reliability and performance of Ecosystem products by driving operational best practices for monitoring, logging, and incident response.
Optimize the team’s workflow by implementing automation and improving processes where needed.
Maintain a high level of code quality and system robustness by promoting test-driven development and continuous integration.

About You

You are a seasoned engineering leader with a passion for building great products, fostering strong teams, and solving challenging technical problems. You have a track record of managing high-performing engineering teams and driving technical projects from concept to delivery geared towards helping 3rd party developers build impactful apps quickly and successfully (ex. Shopify, Atlassian, HubSpot, Slack, etc.)

Must Have Qualifications

10+ years of experience as a software engineer, with 5+ years in an engineering management or leadership role.
Experience building and launching 0 → 1 ecosystem features, platform extensibility (UI components, frameworks, APIs), developer tooling and/or products for external technical audiences.
Proven experience leading teams in fast-paced, agile environments.
Strong background in backend or frontend development (experience with React, Java a plus).
Demonstrated ability to coach and mentor engineers, helping them grow and succeed.
Experience managing the full software development lifecycle, from design through production support.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Nice-to-Have

Familiarity with API development, cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
Prior experience working in a SaaS or cloud-based environment.
A passion for building systems that prioritize scalability, performance, and operational excellence.

The reasonably estimated base salary for this role ranges from $260,000 to $300,000, plus a competitive equity package. Actual compensation is based on the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience.

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

Equal opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

Experience managing and scaling engineering teams of 20+ people

Background in AI/ML infrastructure, networking ASICs, or high-performance switching products
Deep expertise with Cadence and/or Synopsys physical design tools and flows
Experience with advanced DFT integration and design for manufacturability (DFM)

jobs.description:
About Amigo

At Amigo, we're building the clinical AI infrastructure that health systems, life sciences companies, payors, and government agencies run their patient-facing care on. Our agents work across the whole patient journey: pre-visit intake, care navigation, post-visit care plans, and ongoing monitoring. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time.

This hasn’t been solved because the underlying record was never built for it. EHRs were designed for billing, not for systems that learn. So instead of layering another point solution on top, we’re rebuilding the medical record as a timeline of clinical events and running agents on top of it that improve with every patient interaction. Unlike single-purpose chatbots or scribes, Amigo is the platform our customers use to build their own agents. That means our work has to hold up across specialties, workflows, and regulatory environments and not just one narrow use case.

Our agents have supported more than 4 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. Our work is validated through partnerships with leading academic medical institutions. We’re fresh off our Series A, backed by Tier 1 VCs such as Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures.

We’re a small team of around 35 people, working in person in New York City and San Francisco. We care deeply about craft, clinical rigor, and the speed at which good ideas reach patients. If you want your work to be measured in outcomes rather than releases, we’d like to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Lead and grow engineering across application, backend and infrastructure, and data, supporting engineers with mentorship, direct feedback, and clear technical guidance
Hire engineers and develop leaders, building a team that continuously raises its own bar
Drive execution from problem definition through deployment, balancing speed with the reliability a clinical setting demands
Engage deeply in technical discussions, guiding system design and helping the team navigate architectural tradeoffs
Set the engineering culture: how we review code, how we ship, what we consider done, and how we respond when production issues arise
Break large platform problems into increments that deliver value early while still supporting the platform’s long-term direction
Partner with the Applied AI, Forward Deployed, and product teams to align priorities and decide what the platform should absorb versus what remains bespoke per customer
Keep the team fluent in the reliability, security, and privacy implications of what they build in an environment involving patient data

What We're Looking For

A track record of engineering leadership in organizations with a strong engineering culture.
Breadth across more than one of application, backend and infrastructure, and data platform. This role spans all three, so we're looking for a generalist leader rather than a specialist in one area
Experience managing and developing engineers, including hiring, mentorship, and performance conversations, with examples of people who grew under you
A strong technical background, and enough current depth to engage credibly in system design, architecture, and tradeoff decisions
The ability to translate customer needs and engineering goals into a roadmap and then into shipped systems
Excellent communication across engineering, product, and the customer-facing teams, including the judgment to know when to escalate and when to absorb
A deep sense of ownership for both team outcomes and long-term system health
Comfort with ambiguity. Priorities move as deployments teach us what customers actually need
Healthcare experience is not required. Strong engineering leadership transfers, and the clinical context is learnable

Nice to have

Experience leading engineering inside a data-heavy company, or owning a data platform alongside application and backend teams
Background in highly scalable distributed systems or infrastructure platforms
Experience building platforms or products consumed directly by other engineers
Familiarity with regulated environments, whether healthcare, financial services, or the public sector

Benefits (available To Full-Time Employees)

Health & Wellness

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
Daily catered lunch and dinner
Mental health support and wellness coaching
Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth

Growth & Development

Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences
Conference attendance budget for professional development
Annual team offsite
Academic collaboration opportunities
Unlimited PTO

Our Core Values

Patients Win, We Win

If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it.

High Standards, High Care

We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas—not despite our standards, but because of them.

Thoughtful Urgency

We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both.

Intensely Measured

We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. Who Builds With Us

Low ego: Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them.
Direct: You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided.
High agency: You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else.
Bar of excellence: You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same.
Skeptical: You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place.

Compensation Range: $300K - $500K

PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real.

Come join us.

We're living through a fundamental shift in how people discover, evaluate, and purchase products. The next generation doesn't respond to traditional marketing -- they build relationships with brands through authentic social interactions, seek recommendations from communities they trust, and expect personalized experiences that feel human, not corporate.

At Nectar Social, we're building the AI-native social operating system that enables this new era of commerce. We believe every social interaction should deepen the relationship between brands and their communities while creating genuine value for both sides.

Cosmetics, Kosas, OLIPOP, and many more. We're building the future of social commerce -- where community, conversation, and commerce converge.

The Role

We are looking for a Director of Engineering
who operates with the mindset of a product executive to lead, align, and scale our core engineering organization. Our team includes multiple core engineering groups focused on customer-facing product development, as well as a Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) function that moves fast across the full stack on high-priority enterprise initiatives. Under your leadership, these teams will build and scale high-throughput systems that ingest large volumes of social data, run real-time AI agents, and deliver insights through analytics and automation.

This is an executive-level leadership role that bridges technical vision, organizational scale, and business strategy. At the same time, you will build and empower high-performing engineering teams, manage engineering managers and leads, establish systemic technical quality, and guide our engineering organization as we scale from ~50 people into our next phase of growth.

What You'll Be Doing

Organizational Leadership & Team Scaling: Lead, manage, and mentor a high-performing engineering organization, including Engineering Managers and Tech Leads. Build scalable org structures, career ladders, and succession plans to retain top talent.
Product & Strategic Alignment: Partner directly with the CEO and executive peers to define long-term roadmaps, align engineering capacity with business priorities, and turn product vision into predictable technical execution.
Technical Vision & System Governance: Set the high-level technical strategy, architecture principles, and infrastructure roadmap. Ensure scalable system architecture across teams handling high-volume real-time data and AI agentic workflows.
Execution & Delivery Excellence: Drive operational rigor across all engineering teams. Establish clear metrics for delivery velocity, system reliability, code quality, and operational health.
Customer & Market Empathy: Engage directly with key enterprise customers and prospects to understand user pain points, build deep business intuition, and ensure technical investments map directly to business value.
Engineering Culture & Processes: Shape engineering culture as the company scales. Refine organizational processes around architecture reviews, incident response, resource allocation, and continuous improvement.
Hiring & Employer Brand: Partner with Talent Acquisition to scale the engineering department, driving talent acquisition strategies, executive hiring, and interviewing standards for top-tier technical talent.

What We're Looking For

Experience Level: 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years in a senior leadership role (Director, Head of Engineering) managing managers and leading multi-team organizations.
Track Record of Scaling: Proven experience growing engineering teams and organizational structures through key growth phases (e.g., scaling orgs from 30 to 100+ engineers).
Strategic Product Acumen: Strong business and product instincts with a track record of translating complex product objectives into achievable engineering roadmaps and resource plans.
Technical Depth: Deep foundational technical background with the ability to hold engineering teams accountable, evaluate high-level architectural trade-offs, and participate in complex technical discussions.
Executive Cross-Functional Collaboration: History of working seamlessly alongside Product, Design, Sales, and Customer Success executives in fast-paced startup environments.
Operational Mastery: Demonstrated ability to implement light-footprint, high-impact processes that maintain speed and quality without introducing unnecessary bureaucracy.
Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting technical strategy to executive leadership, boards, and customers.

Bonus Points

Domain Expertise: Experience leading engineering teams in B2B SaaS, social data platforms, developer tools, or marketing technology.
AI & Data Infrastructure at Scale: Experience overseeing teams building, deploying, or operating AI-powered systems, real-time analytics platforms, or agentic frameworks.
Tech Stack Alignment: Strategic familiarity with modern cloud and data stacks such as AWS, TypeScript/React, Postgres, ClickHouse, and modern infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Pulumi).
Cross-Platform Leadership: Executive oversight of teams delivering both web and native mobile application ecosystems.

Experiment, design, and influence rigorously the creation of new kinds of experiences for consumers and the new business models that will support builders, creators, partners, and developers.

Optimize the team’s workflow by implementing automation and improving processes where needed.

new_jobs.description:
About Amigo

At Amigo, we're building the clinical AI infrastructure that health systems, life sciences companies, payors, and government agencies run their patient-facing care on. Our agents work across the whole patient journey: pre-visit intake, care navigation, post-visit care plans, and ongoing monitoring. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time.

This hasn’t been solved because the underlying record was never built for it. EHRs were designed for billing, not for systems that learn. So instead of layering another point solution on top, we’re rebuilding the medical record as a timeline of clinical events and running agents on top of it that improve with every patient interaction. Unlike single-purpose chatbots or scribes, Amigo is the platform our customers use to build their own agents. That means our work has to hold up across specialties, workflows, and regulatory environments and not just one narrow use case.

Our agents have supported more than 4 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. Our work is validated through partnerships with leading academic medical institutions. We’re fresh off our Series A, backed by Tier 1 VCs such as Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures.

We’re a small team of around 35 people, working in person in New York City and San Francisco. We care deeply about craft, clinical rigor, and the speed at which good ideas reach patients. If you want your work to be measured in outcomes rather than releases, we’d like to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Lead and grow engineering across application, backend and infrastructure, and data, supporting engineers with mentorship, direct feedback, and clear technical guidance
Hire engineers and develop leaders, building a team that continuously raises its own bar
Drive execution from problem definition through deployment, balancing speed with the reliability a clinical setting demands
Engage deeply in technical discussions, guiding system design and helping the team navigate architectural tradeoffs
Set the engineering culture: how we review code, how we ship, what we consider done, and how we respond when production issues arise
Break large platform problems into increments that deliver value early while still supporting the platform’s long-term direction
Partner with the Applied AI, Forward Deployed, and product teams to align priorities and decide what the platform should absorb versus what remains bespoke per customer
Keep the team fluent in the reliability, security, and privacy implications of what they build in an environment involving patient data

What We're Looking For

A track record of engineering leadership in organizations with a strong engineering culture.
Breadth across more than one of application, backend and infrastructure, and data platform. This role spans all three, so we're looking for a generalist leader rather than a specialist in one area
Experience managing and developing engineers, including hiring, mentorship, and performance conversations, with examples of people who grew under you
A strong technical background, and enough current depth to engage credibly in system design, architecture, and tradeoff decisions
The ability to translate customer needs and engineering goals into a roadmap and then into shipped systems
Excellent communication across engineering, product, and the customer-facing teams, including the judgment to know when to escalate and when to absorb
A deep sense of ownership for both team outcomes and long-term system health
Comfort with ambiguity. Priorities move as deployments teach us what customers actually need
Healthcare experience is not required. Strong engineering leadership transfers, and the clinical context is learnable

Nice to have

Experience leading engineering inside a data-heavy company, or owning a data platform alongside application and backend teams
Background in highly scalable distributed systems or infrastructure platforms
Experience building platforms or products consumed directly by other engineers
Familiarity with regulated environments, whether healthcare, financial services, or the public sector

Benefits (available To Full-Time Employees)

Health & Wellness

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
Daily catered lunch and dinner
Mental health support and wellness coaching
Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth

Growth & Development

Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences
Conference attendance budget for professional development
Annual team offsite
Academic collaboration opportunities
Unlimited PTO

Our Core Values

Patients Win, We Win

If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it.

High Standards, High Care

We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas—not despite our standards, but because of them.

Thoughtful Urgency

We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both.

Intensely Measured

We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. Who Builds With Us

Low ego: Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them.
Direct: You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided.
High agency: You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else.
Bar of excellence: You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same.
Skeptical: You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place.

Compensation Range: $300K - $500K

new_jobs.description:
PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems.

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries.

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure.

In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale.

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact.

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real.

Come join us.

Job Summary

PsiQuantum is leading the U.S.’s largest quantum computing project as the anchor tenant of the Illinois Quantum and Microelectronics Park (IQMP) in Chicago. The strength of the region’s universities, national laboratories, and science and technology ecosystem creates opportunities for PsiQuantum to advance its strategy through external partnerships.

The Senior Director, Technology Partnerships leads PsiQuantum’s engagement with the research and education ecosystem in Chicago and the broader region. This role serves as the primary bridge between PsiQuantum’s technical teams and external partners, identifying and shaping technical collaborations, translating external opportunities into coordinated internal action, and representing PsiQuantum as a scientifically credible leader.

The role requires strong technical fluency, institutional judgment, and the ability to build and sustain trusted relationships across organizational boundaries. Success depends on developing a focused portfolio of partnerships that are aligned with PsiQuantum’s roadmap and business priorities, appropriately sponsored and resourced, and structured around strategically valuable outcomes.

Responsibilities

Develop and lead PsiQuantum’s technology partnerships strategy for Chicago and the broader regional ecosystem, including universities, national laboratories, research consortia, and other members of the science and technology ecosystem.
Serve as PsiQuantum’s principal technical point of contact and spokesperson for external stakeholders in the region, deliver technical presentations, participate in public and private forums, and lead the company’s scientific and technical engagement with the ecosystem.
Build and maintain strategic partnerships with universities and national laboratories, develop collaborative research programs, and facilitate the company’s access to specialized technical expertise and capabilities, where aligned with PsiQuantum priorities.
Work with PsiQuantum’s technical and organizational leaders to evaluate prospective collaborations, establish internal sponsorship, define responsibilities and resource requirements, transition approved activities into execution, and maintain responsibility for the overall institutional relationship.
Coordinate with the Senior Director, Federal Scientific Partnerships, on development and capture of federal funding opportunities that involve regional partners. Participate in the development of joint funding proposals and represent PsiQuantum in multi-party submissions.
Serve as a trusted private-sector sounding board to regional colleges and universities on technical skills needed for the quantum computing industry.
Coordinate with PsiQuantum’s talent acquisition team to leverage relationships with regional universities and national laboratories to support internships, recruiting, and long-term talent pipeline development.

Experience/Qualifications

Ph.D. in a relevant technical field.
Minimum of 10 years of applicable professional experience, such as scientific research, advanced technology development, technology partnerships or commercialization, or similar.
Strong technical fluency and credibility with researchers, faculty, senior institutional leaders, government stakeholders, and private-sector executives.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills and an exceptional ability to translate complex technical subject matter for scientific, government, business, and public audiences.
Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic, and sometimes ambiguous environment.
Ability to travel as required.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with the research, educational, and innovation ecosystem in Chicago, Illinois, and the Midwest.
Existing relationships with universities, national laboratories, research consortia, and other science and technology organizations in the region.
Experience developing multi-institutional research collaborations, joint proposals, or other funded technical projects.
Understanding of fault-tolerant quantum computing, computational science, integrated photonics, or other related fields of advanced technology.
Experience and comfort working across private sector, academic, national laboratory, and government settings.

About Us

We're building the intelligence layer for the home: ambient, proactive, and built into a family of devices, a central hub, accessories, and the software that ties them together. We’re a Series A startup backed by a tier-1 VC & technology partners, with an ex-unicorn founder. Early team, moving fast.

The Role

This is a player-coach role at a critical moment. You'll manage and scale a high-performing team while staying close to the work — setting engineering standards, unblocking execution, and ensuring we ship fast without accumulating debt that slows us down later.

What You'll Do

Lead, grow, and retain a world-class software engineering team across consumer software and AI
Own engineering execution — sprint planning, resourcing, delivery, and team health
Set and enforce engineering standards: code quality, architecture patterns, review culture, and on-call practices
Partner with product and design to scope work, surface tradeoffs, and hit milestones
Recruit aggressively — you'll be a key part of building the team around you
Serve as the connective tissue between individual engineers and company leadership

You

8+ years in software engineering, with 3+ years managing engineering teams
Deep experience shipping consumer-facing software — you know what a polished, high-quality product takes
Fluent in AI/ML-integrated systems — you've worked on products where models are core to the experience, not a bolt-on
Strong people manager: you develop engineers, give direct feedback, and build team culture
Execution-oriented — you keep things moving, resolve ambiguity, and protect the team from noise
Technically credible enough to earn respect from strong engineers without needing to be in every design decision

Why Join

You'll be building and leading the engineering team behind a product that's genuinely new — an ambient AI presence in the home. Small team, real ownership, close to the decision-making, and the opportunity to set engineering culture from scratch. We're well-capitalized and moving fast.
